requirement: A comment sent to Tracy is resolved as Tracy when a write cites its latest send; a reply reopens it; Ask Tracy to edit all leaves a sent, unchanged comment unticked with Sent hh:mm; the chat report lists it

oracle.ref: PR #822 (feat); fix evidence: 03/10: comments sent with Send all stayed open after Tracy did them; the next Send all ticked and re-sent them and Tracy redid the work (ADR 0025).
oracle.invariant: S2: the sent list holds C with `at` = the send's time. S3: Apply answers ok:true; row C has status 'resolved', resolvedByTracy true, resolvedBy {accountId:'', email:'', name:'Tracy', initial:'T', tracy:true}, and its last send's answeredAt set. S4: parent.status 'pending' and parent.resolvedByTracy false; the sent list no longer holds C (new words after the send). S5: a row of a comment already sent with nothing new since is unticked and shows 'Sent HH:MM' (24-hour); U's row (never sent) is ticked and has no [data-sent-at]. S6 (when Tracy's write cites U's request number): the report door lists U with done true; the chat shows [data-tracy-comment-report] reading 'Done: 1 comment (reply to a comment if you want more changes)' with a line data-report-comment=U; row U is resolved with resolvedByTracy true. When no write cited it: the report lists U with done false and the chat reads "Couldn't confirm: 1 comment" — never 'not done' — and U stays open.
